📋 **Staff Transfers**

Thank you for your interest in transferring to Los Angeles Roleplay!

Transfer availability is determined by our Directorship Team. A staff member will confirm whether transfers are currently open.

Please provide your current rank, previous server, and relevant experience.

🛡️ **Staff Applications**

Thank you for your interest in joining the Los Angeles Roleplay Staff Team!

Application availability is announced through our official Discord channels.

Please check our announcements or wait for a staff member to provide further information.

⚖️ **Ban Appeals**

We're sorry to hear about your moderation concern.

Please provide:
• Your Roblox username
• The reason for your ban
• The approximate date of the punishment
• Why you believe the punishment should be reconsidered

A staff member will review your request.

🚨 **Staff Reports**

We take reports against staff members seriously.

Please provide:
• The staff member's username
• A detailed explanation
• Any available evidence
• The approximate date and time

Your report will be reviewed by authorized personnel.

🚨 **Player Reports**

Thank you for helping maintain a safe roleplay environment!

Please provide the player's Roblox username, the rule allegedly violated, and any supporting evidence.

A staff member will assist you shortly.

🎮 **Session Information**

Our sessions are announced in the designated session channel.

Please check the latest announcements for session information. Session times depend on host availability.

🚔 **Joining Los Angeles Roleplay**

To join our ER:LC server:

1. Open Emergency Response: Liberty County on Roblox.
2. Navigate to the private server menu.
3. Enter the private server code provided in our official Discord channels.
4. Follow all server rules and instructions.

If you need assistance, a staff member will help you.

✅ **Roblox Verification**

To verify your Roblox account:

1. Navigate to our verification channel.
2. Click the **Verify** button.
3. Copy your unique `;verify` command.
4. Join our ER:LC private server.
5. Paste the command into the in-game chat.

Once verification is confirmed, your Roblox account will be linked to Discord.

🚓 **Department Applications**

Interested in joining one of our departments?

Please check the department's official recruitment announcements for application availability and requirements.

A department representative can assist with additional questions.

⭐ **Staff Promotions**

Promotions are determined by authorized leadership based on factors such as activity, professionalism, performance, and contributions.

Promotions are not guaranteed. Please contact your supervisor for further information.

💎 **Donations & Support**

Thank you for your interest in supporting Los Angeles Roleplay!

Please refer to our official announcements for any available supporter options.

A staff member can clarify current offerings and eligibility.

🤝 **Partnership Requests**

Thank you for your interest in partnering with Los Angeles Roleplay!

Please provide:
• Your community name
• Discord invite or community information
• Member count
• Reason for requesting a partnership

Our Directorship Team will review your request.

👑 **Directorship Inquiries**

Directorship positions are managed by authorized server leadership.

Please provide details about your inquiry. A member of the appropriate leadership team will review it.

🔧 **Technical Support**

We're sorry you're experiencing technical difficulties.

Please provide:
• A description of the issue
• The steps that caused it
• Any relevant screenshots
• Whether the issue is still occurring

A staff member will investigate.

📖 **Server Rules**

All members are expected to follow the official Los Angeles Roleplay rules.

Please review the designated rules channel before participating in a session.

If you need clarification, a staff member will assist you.

📅 **Leave of Absence**

If you need to request a Leave of Absence, please follow the appropriate staff procedures.

Provide your requested start date, end date, and a brief explanation if required.

Your supervisor will review the request.

📝 **Community Complaints**

Thank you for bringing your concern to our attention.

Please explain what happened, who was involved, and provide any available evidence.

An authorized staff member will review your concern.

✅ **Ticket Resolution**

If your issue has been resolved, please let the support team know.

An authorized staff member can close the ticket once assistance is complete.

Thank you for contacting Los Angeles Roleplay Support!
